video_title: 2026 Hornets Training Camp Media Availability: Grayson Allen

quotes.speaker: Grayson Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Grayson Allen praises Royce O'Neale as a versatile teammate and improved shooter.
quotes.excerpt: He is an incredibly improved shooter from when I played with him in Utah
quotes.quote: He is great. He is a team guy. His game is trying to make the other guys on the court better, the team better, offensively and defensively. He is an incredibly improved shooter from when I played with him in Utah and he is a great shooter now, a good connector and passer, great screener offensively. Defensively he is physical, can guard multiple positions, so just a really really good teammate and versatile guy to have.
quotes.social_post: Grayson Allen says Royce O'Neale has become an incredibly improved shooter since their time together in Utah, calling him a great teammate and a versatile player for the Hornets.
